candidates.prompt_text: What is one healthy thing you do every morning? Please describe it and say when you do it.
suggested_ideas: eat breakfast at a regular time

evaluation_guide.expected_content: A short personal description of one morning healthy routine, with a simple time reference and one or two details about the action.
evaluation_guide.key_points: Names one healthy action; says when it happens in the morning; adds a small detail such as place, duration, or feeling.
evaluation_guide.acceptable_responses: Any clear, simple answer about a safe daily morning habit is acceptable, such as drinking water, stretching, washing face, walking, or eating breakfast.
evaluation_guide.off_topic_examples: Talking only about weekend entertainment; describing another person’s routine without mentioning the speaker; discussing unhealthy habits only.
evaluation_guide.scoring_hints: For pronunciation, focus on clear individual sounds, word stress in common routine words, and intelligibility of short phrases. Minor grammar mistakes are acceptable if speech is understandable.
evaluation_guide.common_mistakes: Very short one-word answers; unclear ending sounds; missing time information; speaking too fast so key words are hard to understand.

candidates.prompt_text: Tell me about a healthy food or drink you often have in a normal day.

evaluation_guide.expected_content: A brief description of one healthy food or drink the student often has, with simple details about time, taste, or reason.
evaluation_guide.key_points: Names the food or drink; says when or how often they have it; gives one simple detail such as taste, benefit, or meal.
evaluation_guide.acceptable_responses: Any common healthy item is acceptable, including fruit, vegetables, water, milk, soup, or a simple balanced meal.
evaluation_guide.off_topic_examples: Listing only favorite junk food; discussing prices or shopping problems instead of the routine; giving a memorized speech about world nutrition.
evaluation_guide.scoring_hints: Listen for clear vowel and consonant production in familiar food words, understandable stress patterns, and overall intelligibility. Content can stay simple.
evaluation_guide.common_mistakes: Naming an item without any detail; repeating the same word many times; dropping important sounds so the food or drink is difficult to identify.

candidates.prompt_text: How do you keep your body active during the week? Describe one simple activity you do.
suggested_ideas: playing a simple sport or doing exercise

evaluation_guide.expected_content: A simple spoken description of one regular physical activity, including what the student does and how often or when they do it.
evaluation_guide.key_points: Mentions one activity; explains when, where, or how often; adds one easy detail such as duration or feeling after doing it.
evaluation_guide.acceptable_responses: Any accessible activity is acceptable, such as walking, stretching, running, cycling, dancing, or exercise at school or at home.
evaluation_guide.off_topic_examples: Talking only about watching sports; describing a holiday trip; giving medical advice or technical fitness information.
evaluation_guide.scoring_hints: Assess whether the student can pronounce common action words clearly and maintain understandable rhythm across short sentences. A basic answer can still score well if intelligible.
evaluation_guide.common_mistakes: Speaking in isolated words only; unclear stress in activity words; no time or frequency detail; long pauses that break the answer.
